count_notes.weapons: 13 weapon rows in code/game/bg_misc.c (10 base, 3 inside the MISSIONPACK block at lines 657-917). Item rows total 51 (35 base, 16 mission-pack). Armour tiers: 3. Health tiers: 4.
count_notes.creatures: 0 creature records in the box. No monster table; the only AI opponents are bots (code/game/g_bot.c, ai_*.c).

creature_families: No monster families in the box. The bot AI (code/game/g_bot.c, ai_main.c, ai_dmq3.c) drives player-like opponents, not beasts.
Bot difficulty ladder: skill clamped to 1-5 (g_bot.c line 778); handicap 50 for skill in [1,2) at line 671, 70 for [2,3), 90 for [3,4) (g_bot.c lines 670-677).

top_creatures.label: Skill-banded bot (analogue, not a creature)
top_creatures.why: A single 1-5 number sets an opponent's handicap in bands, so difficulty reads as one dial.
top_creatures.keep: One difficulty number per opponent, mapped to a small set of bands.
top_creatures.change: Our bands are data on the enemy row, and the handicap maps to aim and reaction, not a single value.

classes: No character classes or races in the box. Player models are pk3 data (not read).
No XP or class progression in the box.
Team flags only: red and blue flag items (code/game/bg_misc.c team_CTF_redflag and team_CTF_blueflag rows, lines 627-660).

Game modes (code/game/bg_public.h lines 103-114): free-for-all, one-on-one tournament, single-player FFA, team deathmatch, CTF, and mission-pack modes (one-flag CTF, obelisk, harvester). Modes are not zones.

Projectile: grenade launcher (241), rocket launcher (257), plasma gun (305), BFG10K (321).
Mission-pack only (inside the MISSIONPACK block, 657-917): nailgun (868), proximity launcher (884), chaingun (905).
Weapon rows give first-pickup ammo: railgun 10 (line 295), plasma gun 50 (line 311), BFG 20 (line 327). No elemental or set properties.
Visual tiers: none. Weapons are slots, not tiers. Always picked up (bg_misc.c line 1053).
gear_tiers: Armour: shard 5 (bg_misc.c line 68 row; icon row 73), combat armour 50 (row 85; icon row 89), heavy armour 100 (row 101; icon row 105). Tier shown by icon colour and model name.
Armour and mega health can overflow max: armour cap is 2x max health (bg_misc.c line 1079; g_items.c Pickup_Armor).
Health: 5, 25, 50 and mega 100 (rows 120-185). Respawn: armour 25 s, health 35 s, mega health 35 s (g_items.c RESPAWN_ARMOR, RESPAWN_HEALTH, RESPAWN_MEGAHEALTH defines, lines 39-44).
Mission-pack persistent power-ups (scout, guard, doubler, ammo regen; bg_misc.c rows 765-816) can be held one at a time (IT_PERSISTANT_POWERUP, bg_misc.c around line 1108).
Material looks (metal, gold, crystal): not in the box; they live in pk3 MD3 models (not read).
zones: No zone, dungeon or biome records in the box. Maps are pk3 data (not read).
Hazards: none as data in the box. code/game/g_trigger.c, g_mover.c, g_target.c present, not read.
Game modes are the only arena-like list in the box (bg_public.h lines 103-114). g_arenas.c present, not read.

looks.label: Quad dynamic light
looks.technique: A blue dynamic light at the player with radius 200 plus a random 0-31 each frame (cg_players.c line 1852), plus a quad overlay shader (lines 2168-2174).

looks.label: Regeneration flicker
looks.technique: The overlay shows only in one 100 ms slice of each second, from (cg.time / 100) % 10 == 1 (cg_players.c line 2177).

looks.label: Invisibility swap
looks.technique: The body is drawn with an invisibility shader instead of the normal shader, and no shadow is drawn while invisible (cg_players.c lines 2016-2017 and 2153).

looks.label: Power-up expiry warning
looks.technique: A wear-off sound plays at each blink window before a timer ends (cg_view.c CG_PowerupTimerSounds, lines 702-720; sound at line 716). POWERUP_BLINKS and POWERUP_BLINK_TIME are used at 712-715 but their definitions were not found under code/ (grep).

looks.label: Railgun spiral trail
looks.technique: A stack of rings (radius 4, rotation 1, spacing 5 defines at cg_weapons.c lines 223-225) along the shot, in the shooter's colour (line 244), fading by a time-based lifetime (lines 215-262).

looks.label: Lightning beam from muzzle
looks.technique: A beam from a computed muzzle point to the first hit, built each frame (cg_weapons.c CG_LightningBolt, from line 1062; muzzle setup read only).

looks.label: Screen-space damage blob
looks.technique: A camera-facing sprite on the view, alpha falling from 200 across DAMAGE_TIME (500 ms, cg_local.h line 41; alpha at cg_view.c line 601), off when blood is disabled.

looks.label: Gib burst with upward kick
looks.technique: Gib parts launch with random horizontal velocity (250) and an upward jump (250) (cg_effects.c defines at lines 562-563; launch at line 574).

looks.label: Blood sprite, hidden on own view
looks.technique: A blood explosion sprite lasting 500 ms (cg_effects.c line 507), random rotation, flagged third-person when it is the player's own blood.

looks.label: Hovering pickups
looks.technique: Armour and power-up rows carry the suspended flag, so they hover above the ground (bg_misc.c line 65 for armour, line 521 for power-ups).

looks.label: Power-up stacking timer
looks.technique: A new pickup adds quantity times 1000 ms to the existing timer; a first pickup starts the timer on a whole second so timers stay in step (g_items.c lines 54-58 and 67).

looks.label: Rival-grab denial
looks.technique: A power-up pickup flags nearby players who are within 192 units (line 96), in front (dot 0.4 or more, line 102) and in line of sight (trace line 107) with the denied-reward player event (line 113). Client side not read.

originals.name: Rival-grab denial cue
originals.idea: When a hero takes a buff pickup, nearby players who face it and can see it get a short denial cue.
originals.keep: The three gates: range, facing, and line of sight.
originals.change: Our cue is a distinct sound and a HUD ring; the gate is server-verified (parity row 18).

originals.name: Stacking buff clock
originals.idea: A second buff adds to the timer instead of resetting it, and timers start on whole seconds.
originals.change: Buffs and their durations are data fields on the item row.

originals.name: Expiry blink warning
originals.idea: A buff gives a warning window with a sound before it ends.
originals.change: Window length is set per buff.

originals.name: Shooter-colour spiral trail
originals.idea: A ranged shot draws rings in its owner's colour that fade.
originals.change: Our beam is a ribbon; the rings are off on the low quality tier.

originals.name: Hover pickup with overflow glow
originals.idea: Pickups hover; armour and health can overflow their max and the overflow glow fades.
originals.change: A ring of light, not a box; the overflow sits in the thumb-zone HUD.

originals.name: Death burst with upward kick
originals.idea: A death throws parts up at random from a fixed velocity.
originals.keep: Random horizontal spread with a fixed upward kick.
originals.change: Our kick and part list are per creature (parity row 17).
